title: LIN: Adding support for LIN dissection
description:
This patch adds support for LIN (Local Interconnect Network) as well as support for:
- Signal PDUs on LIN
- ISO 15765 (ISO TP) on LIN - this is needed for UDS on LIN
- TECMP transported LIN is handle like LIN

LIN is a simple automotive fieldbus to connect for example simple
sensors and actuators to an electronic control unit.

assigned to @LarsVoelker and unassigned @ws-gitlab-utility

OK, so this is `LINKTYPE_LIN`.

That's not currently documented on https://www.tcpdump.org/linktypes.html; should an item for it point to ISO 17987?  A search for "LIN Specification 2.2a" online found https://www.ihr.de/index.php/en/downloads/category/9-lin-spezifikationen, but that says "Only registered and logged in users can download files from this category.", and a bunch of stuff that the search found says "...the latest LIN specification (2.2A) is being transcribed to the ISO...", which sounds as if pointing to the ISO standard would be the right idea.
assigned to @ws-gitlab-utility
